intent: A single-select segmented control: mutually exclusive options as one connected row of icons and/or labels.
use_when: 2–4 mutually exclusive options in one row (mode, alignment, view).
An inspector toggle group that reads as one enclosed control.
dont_use_when: Many options — use a Dropdown / menu.
Independent on/off toggles — use grouped icon buttons.

slots.segments: Segment[] (value, label?, icon?, ariaLabel?) — the options.

a11y.segments: each is a <button> with aria-pressed and its own aria-label; keyboard single-selection.
a11y.labelless: icon-only segments still carry an aria-label.

code.example:
<SegmentedControl ariaLabel="Alignment" value={align} onChange={setAlign}
  segments={[{ value: 'left', ariaLabel: 'Left', icon: <AlignLeft/> }, { value: 'center', ariaLabel: 'Center', icon: <AlignCenter/> }]} />
